runtimeNotes.currentImplementation: procedural SceneView headless body blockout with calculated shoulder-elbow-wrist and hip-knee-ankle chains; limb segment axes are aligned to their pivot-to-pivot vectors; dance includes a subtle lateral torso-flex approximation through coordinated upper-torso and waist offsets, not a true skeletal rotation; the original portrait remains a static independent overlay; production-grade mesh, inverse-kinematics solver and imported GLB asset are not available; wrist flex is approximated with independent palm-angle offsets, and simplified finger capsules follow each palm orientation; this is not anatomical hand skinning or detailed finger articulation
runtimeNotes.futureBodyRenderer: refine the geometric body-only blockout with detailed separate body geometry and production skinning while keeping the original portrait overlay byte-for-byte unchanged; no head, neck, face or hair geometry belongs to this body reference
runtimeNotes.speech: Android TTS is audio-only and must never drive facial animation
